FlowerPainter.Floral.Issue.FillPartition: Choose flowers, then click a subdivision to fill it.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flowers.PartitionFillTi: Choose flowers and click a subdivision. The hovered subdivision is outlined. Unfilled subdivisions stay empty; boundaries do not plant ribbons.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.PartitionTip: Draw circles or closed shapes, or join a curve to the frame or another boundary. Crossings subdivide the frame; dangling curves do not enclose a region.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.PartitionDragHin: Drag the centre to move, green to resize and orange to rotate. Drag curve nodes to rebuild the subdivision; right-click a node to remove it.
